installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# BungeeCord installation script for Pterodactyl
# Server files: /mnt/server

set -eu

cd /mnt/server

JENKINS_URL="https://hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BungeeCord"

if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "Using supplied download URL: ${DL_PATH}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL="${DL_PATH}"
else
    BUNGEE_VERSION="${BUNGEE_VERSION:-latest}"

    case "${BUNGEE_VERSION}" in
        latest)
            BUNGEE_VERSION="lastSuccessfulBuild"
            ;;
        lastSuccessfulBuild|lastStableBuild)
            ;;
        *[!0-9]*)
            echo "ERROR: Invalid BungeeCord build '${BUNGEE_VERSION}'." >&2
            echo "Use latest, lastSuccessfulBuild, lastStableBuild, or a numeric build number." >&2
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac

    if printf '%s' "${BUNGEE_VERSION}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'; then
        if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 \
            "${JENKINS_URL}/${BUNGEE_VERSION}/api/json" >/dev/null; then
            echo "ERROR: BungeeCord build ${BUNGEE_VERSION} does not exist." >&2
            exit 1
        fi
    fi

    DOWNLOAD_URL="${JENKINS_URL}/${BUNGEE_VERSION}/artifact/bootstrap/target/BungeeCord.jar"

    echo "BungeeCord build: ${BUNGEE_VERSION}"
    echo "Download URL: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
fi

echo "Downloading BungeeCord to ${SERVER_JARFILE}..."

TMP_JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE}.tmp"
rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"

if ! curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 -o "${TMP_JAR}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to download the BungeeCord jar." >&2
    rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "${TMP_JAR}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: The downloaded jar is empty." >&2
    rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"
    exit 1
fi

if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    mv -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi

mv -f "${TMP_JAR}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
echo "BungeeCord installed successfully."

# Create a starter config so Pterodactyl can set the listener and backend
# addresses before BungeeCord boots. Never overwrite an existing config.
if [ ! -f config.yml ]; then
    echo "Creating a default config.yml..."
    cat > config.yml <<'YAML'
servers:
  lobby:
    motd: '&1Another BungeeCord server'
    address: localhost:25565
    restricted: false
listeners:
- query_port: 25577
  motd: '&1Another BungeeCord server'
  tab_list: GLOBAL_PING
  query_enabled: false
  proxy_protocol: false
  forced_hosts:
    pvp.md-5.net: pvp
  ping_passthrough: false
  priorities:
  - lobby
  bind_local_address: true
  host: 0.0.0.0:25577
  max_players: 1
  tab_size: 60
  force_default_server: false
online_mode: true
ip_forward: false
YAML
fi
